entities.name: Xandria
entities.description: A siren of Theros who was once a human scholar from Meletis and refuses to eat humans.

entities.name: Ninis
entities.description: Xandria's classmate and love, claimed by a god.

entities.name: Chakros
entities.description: A mage on a Meletis trireme, killed by sirens.

entities.name: Tolios
entities.description: A shipwreck survivor from Meletis whom Xandria eats.

entities.name: Sirens
entities.description: Immortal singing creatures of the Siren Sea who feast on humans.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Plane where the story takes place.

entities.name: Siren Sea
entities.description: Sea where the sirens are trapped.

events.summary: A god claims Ninis and curses Xandria, who is transformed into a siren trapped in the Siren Sea.
events.quote: She awoke on an island and transformed into a siren .

events.summary: Xandria attacks the sirens to stop them feasting on shipwrecked men; they tear flesh from her in retaliation.
events.quote: each siren tore a peck of flesh from her body

events.summary: A Meletis ship wrecks near the island and the sirens kill the mage Chakros.
events.quote: He fell into the embrace of a siren, who ravenously ate his flesh while he smiled contentedly.

events.summary: Xandria finds the survivor Tolios, who tries to stab her; she sings and subdues him.
events.quote: Reflexively, she burst into song, halting his attack immediately.

events.summary: Xandria bites Tolios's neck and eats him as the other sirens watch.
events.quote: His eyes blazed with ecstasy as she bit deeply into his neck.

relations.quote: There, she had fallen for the handsome Ninis , her classmate.
He was her claim, her food.
She was an outcast among her tribe for refusing to kill humans.
